proposed_connector.completeness: US hydrogen infrastructure tracked via DOE/NREL only; private deployments missing

creative_extensions.rationale: Plug Power claims to operate a North-American hydrogen network. NREL Alternative Fueling Stations is the canonical DOE registry for hydrogen stations — operator name should resolve to multiple sites if claim is true.

creative_extensions.source_label: EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) — Plug Power hydrogen generation facilities
creative_extensions.rationale: Industrial-scale hydrogen handling at 30,000-unit deployment scale implies multiple EPA-permitted hydrogen storage/dispensing sites. EPA FRS would index them.

creative_extensions.signal_direction: EPA-absent for an operator at this claimed scale = facility-scope contradiction
